findings.claim: 10-K：關稅、關稅稅負或採購限制可能墊高客戶專案成本、影響專案時程；貿易政策已影響部分元件（如太陽能板）供應鏈。
findings.excerpt: Any tariffs, duties, taxes, assessments, or other limitations on the availability or sourcing of materials or components for our customers’ projects can also increase costs for customers and create variability of project timing.

findings.claim: 10-K：EPC／固定價合約下負責採購銅、鋼、鋁、變壓器等材料，價格與可得性可能受關稅等全球貿易關係影響。
findings.excerpt: Prices and availability could be materially impacted by, among other things, supply chain and other logistical challenges (including inability of manufacturers to timely meet demand), global trade relationships (e.g., tariffs, duties, taxes, assessments, sourcing restrictions)

findings.claim: 2025 年海外營收 20.0 億美元、佔 7.0%，絕大部分為加拿大與澳洲。
findings.excerpt: For the year ended December 31, 2025, we derived $2.00 billion, or 7.0%, of our consolidated revenues from foreign operations, the substantial majority of which was related to Canada and Australia.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 PWR 專屬 Section 232 或出口管制／實體清單來源；僅 1 次搜尋＋讀 Q3 10-Q（2026-09-30 期，僅見一般性關稅風險用語）。
